question: Approve the ideation direction: split the count grade onto an honest code across BOTH entries=4 pins, at net +80 in one test file?

artifacts.summary: Ideation validated the adversarial review BY EXECUTION — re-ran the matcher harness and re-extracted the live stream first-hand — and confirmed both remedy gaps rather than taking them on report. It then added a finding the review missed: the candidate.txt byte check at :431 is DEAD CODE, unreachable behind verifyRoundArtifacts' digest check inside ValidateRoundFile (round.go:182-210), so the file split requires reordering the two non-record checks BEFORE that call. Its design and falsifying fixture now pin that. Remedy across both pins: pin 1 genericizes to entries=\d+ (host-parity — codex has no stream count pin); pin 2 splits the count onto rejection-round-incomplete via in-function gradedErr with the identity composite untouched. Two honest codes, rejection-round-incomplete and rejection-workflow-file-mutated. The proof cannot green a half-fix: test plan 2 records validation/1 from the existing 2-entry log constant and asserts codes are exactly [rejection-round-incomplete] — a stream-only fix leaves the durable site under the old code and reds that test. AC-1 pins status AND codes, so both softening and the kept lie fail it. Red stays red: gradeLive fails the lane on any non-empty code set. No spike needed, four proven mechanisms named. Surface net +80 in ONE test file, tolerance ±40, hard boundary of no product code and nothing outside internal/ensigncycle.
